registrationTypes.title: Adventure Tour Operator
registrationTypes.description: For applicants seeking statutory registration to operate as an authorized Adventure Tour Operator in Sikkim, organizing mountaineering, trekking, river rafting, paragliding, and outdoor adventure activities.
registrationTypes.targetAudience: Commercial adventure operators, registered agencies, and enterprises with certified adventure safety infrastructure.

registrationTypes.title: Guide Registration
registrationTypes.description: For individual professional guides seeking official government accreditation and registration to provide certified guiding services for trekking, mountaineering, cultural tours, and eco-tourism across Sikkim.
registrationTypes.targetAudience: Individual tour guides, mountaineering guides, and certified trekking escorts residing in Sikkim.
